lines: Lot 7, East Terrace. A decommissioned relay station — stripped to the foundations. Scrap metal, dead wiring, and cracked solar panels litter the ground. But the mounting pads are intact.
Three build pads sit in the northwest corner, ready for new collector installations. A small shelter stands nearby. A community notice board is posted along the path.
This is where you build your own solar infrastructure. Install collectors, generate resources, and start producing the materials the Array won't give you for free.
Sera hands you a technical manual and two collector kits.
'Solar Collector Kits. Install them on the build pads and they'll process ambient light into stabilizing compound — the stuff Master Yun uses for batteries.'
'They take a while to calibrate and start producing. Go explore, do some work, and when you come back they'll have output ready for collection.'

lines: Sera scowls at her equipment next door. 'Those scrap drones are back. Old Array maintenance units gone haywire — they keep stripping wire from my collectors.'
'I need an EMP Charge to fry their circuits. Component Dealer Mira in the market might sell one. Or Master Yun at the workshop could probably rig one up.'
'Help me out and I'll give you a Power Coupler — boosts the output of your next collector installation.'
Sera activates the EMP Charge and tosses it into the scrap pile. A sharp crack of static, then silence.
'There — dead as doornails. They won't be stripping wire anymore.'
'Here — a Power Coupler, as promised. Wire it into one of your build pads before you install a collector. You'll get double the output from that unit.'

The solar collector hums quietly, panels angled toward the twilight sky. Still calibrating — go explore the city or complete some tasks, and it'll be producing when you return.

lines: — EAST TERRACE COMMUNITY BOARD —
LOST CAT: Orange tabby, name 'Ember.' Contact Vell, Lot 3.
TERRACE WATCH: Volunteer needed for nightly perimeter rotation. See Jorrit.
'LOST: Orange tabby, answers to Ember (usually). Last seen heading toward the market district two days ago.'
'If found, please contact Vell at Lot 3, East Terrace. Reward offered.'
Vell is standing right here on the terrace. The cat likes warm places and people who smell like books...

actions.prompt: 'TERRACE WATCH VOLUNTEER NEEDED. One shift, nightly rotation. The terrace neighborhood needs a volunteer to watch the eastern perimeter fence. Compensation: 3 silicon per shift.'

options.label: Sign up
options.description: Volunteer for the terrace watch. You might encounter something.

options.label: Not now
options.description: Maybe later.

actions.text: You sign your name on the roster. The next time you return to the terrace, you'll take your shift.

lines: You take your terrace watch shift. For hours, nothing. The fence hums quietly in the twilight.
Then — movement. Two scrap drones skitter through a gap in the fence, drawn to the solar collectors' energy signatures.
The drones are scrap. Jorrit jogs over from the water station.
'Nice work! Those rogue units have been raiding collector arrays all along the terrace. Here — your share of the watch fund.'
Vell's face lights up. 'Ember's in the Archives? With Solen? Of course she is — that old bookworm's been sneaking her fish scraps for months!'
'Thank you, truly. When you're my age and living alone, a cat's the best company there is.'
Vell presses two ration packs into your hands. 'It's not much, but the terrace shares what it has.'
